name: Motor thermal-capacity permissive
summary: Uses the available motor thermal estimate as a defined start-permission input.
description: Uses the available motor thermal estimate as a defined start-permission input. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Thermal model state” at the input and “Start thermal permission” at the output. A thermal model depends on correct motor data.
